description: Send an email from an existing identity address. 'from' must be an identity created with mail_new_identity. Optional autoReply true asks the server to add Auto-Submitted: auto-replied; false or omission adds no such header. Optional inReplyTo (one angle-bracket Message-ID) and references thread the message; omit both and those headers are not added. Subject is not rewritten. Optional idempotencyKey is sent as the Idempotency-Key header and is not part of the JSON body; it may be combined with inReplyTo and references on the same call. After trim it must be 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters (0x20-0x7E); whitespace-only is rejected. If send-log replay failed at startup, a request with idempotencyKey is REST 503 {error:"idempotency_unavailable"} and does not send; requests without a key are unchanged. There is no headers field.

autoReply.description: True only: server adds Auto-Submitted: auto-replied. False or omitted adds nothing.

from.description: Sender address (must be an existing identity)

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key. After trim, 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters (0x20-0x7E). Whitespace-only is rejected. Sent as the Idempotency-Key header, not in the body.

inReplyTo.description: Optional RFC 5322 Message-ID in angle brackets, e.g. <id@domain>. Sets In-Reply-To and References.

references.description: Optional earlier Message-IDs (1-50, same form). Requires inReplyTo. Deduped; inReplyTo is placed last. If references is too long, keep the last entries that fit.

subject.description: Subject line. Not rewritten; set Re: yourself if you want it.

name: mail_send
title: Send Email
